rows.notes: The study is explicitly a review article (titled 'A Review on Remote Sensing as a Tool for Irrigation Monitoring and Management'; labelled 'Review Article'); it reports no own data, experiment, survey or model runs. It summarises other authors' work on NDWI and water indices (Table 1) and asserts, without own evidence, that NDWI-based water status assessment can be used to plan irrigation and improve WUE. No own result on remote sensing improving crop yields.

Same review article; no primary data. It only states in narrative form that NDWI can help decide when and how much to irrigate and avoid excess or deficit water use, citing other studies (e.g. Gao 1996, Jackson et al. 2004, Bal et al. 2021). No own result on water conservation or prevention of over-irrigation. The conclusion itself notes more research is needed to establish NDWI thresholds for practical irrigation application.
